description: Abstract figure in graphite. The image is contained within a rectangle drawn in a thick line of graphite and surrounded by a border of negative space. Inside the rectangle the drawing is composed of both straight and curving lines, the drawing is shaded throughout in varying degrees. This image is on the verso of 2006.5.65, CR 169.
